newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 9.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- A group of nine officials from the Korea National Red Cross will leave for Beijing on Monday on their way to North Korea to oversee the delivery of some 11,200 tons of corn and corn powder to North Korea.
- A special National Assembly session, which was supposed to convene on Monday, is unlikely to open for the time being due to the conflicting political interests of rival parties.
- A direct shipping line is expected to be established between Pusan and North Korea's Wonsan from October to handle shipments of mineral water and raw materials from North Korea to the South.
- Domestic automakers have decided to forcefully strike back against newcomer Samsung Motors Inc's controversial bid to "artificially restructure" the industry.
